articles.summary: GREENVILLE, S.C., May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United Community Banks, Inc. (NYSE: UCB) (the “Company”), reported that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on July 3, 2026 to shareholders of record as
articles.title: United Community Banks, Inc. Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend on Common Stock
